plan: Given my value of $36, I should aim to bid slightly below my value to maximize profit if I win. Assuming others bid close to their values, bidding around $30-$35 could secure a win without overpaying. If I bid $30, I win if others bid below $30, and my profit is $36 minus the second-highest bid. If others bid higher, I risk nothing. This strategy balances winning chances and profit maximization.
